description: This file contains unit tests for the UsbAccess plugin, using Google Test framework. It tests various functionalities such as method registration, firmware update, file listing, mounted device retrieval, firmware file enumeration, and log archiving-related events. The tests mock underlying system calls and external dependencies to verify correct behavior under different scenarios.

classes.name: UsbAccessTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for UsbAccess plugin, setting up mocks and environment for unit tests of the plugin methods.

classes.name: UsbAccessEventTest
classes.description: Derived test class for testing event-related functions of the UsbAccess plugin, including event subscriptions and event triggering.

classes.name: UsbAccessEventIarmTest
classes.description: Derived test class for testing IARM specific event registration and handling within the UsbAccess plugin.

methods.name: RegisteredMethods
methods.description: Test that verifies registration of plugin methods such as getFileList, createLink, clearLink, getLinks, getAvailableFirmwareFiles, getMounted, updateFirmware, ArchiveLogs.

methods.name: UpdateFirmware
methods.description: Test for the updateFirmware method, checking various cases including valid path, invalid path, and special characters, ensuring the correct system command is constructed and the response is correct.

methods.name: getFileListFailure_BadRequest
methods.description: Test when the getFileList method is invoked with missing path parameter, expecting a BAD_REQUEST error.

methods.name: getFileListFailure_whenDeviceListEmpty

methods.name: getFileListFailure_when_setmntentNull
methods.description: Test when setmntent system call fails to open mounts file, expecting a failure response.

methods.name: getFileListFailure_when_getmntentNull
methods.description: Test when getmntent returns nullptr, meaning no mount entries found, expecting failure.

methods.name: getFileListFailure_when_devNodNotFound
methods.description: Test when device node is not found in list, expecting failure.

methods.name: getFileListSuccess_whenAbsPathFound
methods.description: Test successful retrieval of file list when the absolute mount path is matched.

methods.name: getFileListSuccess_withoutPath

methods.name: getFileListSuccess_withRelativePathParam

methods.name: getFileListSuccess_withSpecialCharacters

methods.name: getMountedFailure_when_setmntentNull
methods.description: Test failure case when setmntent fails to open mounts file during getMounted call.

methods.name: getMountedSuccess_when_getmntentNull

methods.name: getMountedSuccess_whenDeviceListEmpty
methods.description: Test when no devices in the system, expecting an empty list.

methods.name: getMountedSuccess_when_devNodNotFound

methods.name: getMountedSuccess_withUSBMountPath

methods.description: Test success with empty firmware list when getmntent returns nullptr.

methods.name: getAvailableFirmwareFilesSuccess_whenDeviceListEmpty
methods.description: Test success with empty list when no devices are mounted.

methods.name: getAvailableFirmwareFilesSuccess_when_devNodNotFound

methods.name: getAvailableFirmwareFilesSuccess_withBinFiles
methods.description: Test retrieval of firmware files when .bin files are present in mounted directories.

methods.name: ArchiveLogs
